stem.text: Geranyl ethanoate is present in ginger and cocoa, and is used in shampoos and soaps as a perfume. It reacts with an excess of bromine in an organic solvent to give X, a bromo-derivative.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: skeletal formula of geranyl ethanoate (a zig-zag chain with two C=C double bonds and an ethanoate ester group), arrow labelled Br2 to bromo-derivative X

stem.text: Including geranyl ethanoate, how many cis-trans isomers are there of geranyl ethanoate, and how many chiral centres are there in X?
